<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_map"><sys_transform_map action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copy_empty_fields>false</copy_empty_fields><create_new_record_on_empty_coalesce_fields>false</create_new_record_on_empty_coalesce_fields><enforce_mandatory_fields>No</enforce_mandatory_fields><name>Summit Bank - TRIRIGA Space to WSD Space</name><order>100</order><run_business_rules>true</run_business_rules><run_script>true</run_script><script><![CDATA[(function runTransformScript(source, map, log, target) {
  // TRIRIGA -> WSD: build the location hierarchy on the fly and enrich each space
  function ensure(table, name, fields) {
    var g = new GlideRecord(table);
    g.addQuery('name', name);
    for (var k in fields) g.addQuery(k, fields[k]);
    g.query();
    if (g.next()) return g.getUniqueValue();
    g.initialize();
    g.setValue('name', name);
    g.setValue('title', name);
    for (var f in fields) g.setValue(f, fields[f]);
    g.setValue('wsd_source', 'TRIRIGA');
    g.setValue('active', true);
    g.setValue('time_zone', 'US/Eastern'); g.setValue('city', 'Charlotte'); g.setValue('state', 'NC'); g.setValue('country', 'USA');
    return g.insert();
  }
  var site = ensure('sn_wsd_core_site', 'Charlotte, NC', {});
  var campus = ensure('sn_wsd_core_campus', source.getValue('u_tripropertyname'), {site: site, parent: site});
  var building = ensure('sn_wsd_core_building', source.getValue('u_tribuildingname'), {site: site, campus: campus, parent: campus});
  var floor = ensure('sn_wsd_core_floor', source.getValue('u_tribuildingname') + ' - ' + source.getValue('u_trifloorname'), {site: site, campus: campus, building: building, parent: building});

  var typeMap = {'Desk': 'Workspace/Desk', 'Meeting room': 'Room', 'Focus room': 'Room', 'Office': 'Room', 'Break room': 'Café'};
  var st = new GlideRecord('sn_wsd_core_space_type');
  if (st.get('name', typeMap[source.getValue('u_trispaceclass')] || 'Miscellaneous')) target.location_type = st.getUniqueValue();

  var dept = new GlideRecord('cmn_department');
  var org = source.getValue('u_triorgname');
  if (org) { if (!dept.get('name', org)) { dept.initialize(); dept.name = org; dept.insert(); } target.department = dept.getUniqueValue(); }

  target.site = site; target.campus = campus; target.building = building; target.floor = floor; target.parent = floor;
  target.wsd_source = 'TRIRIGA';
  target.is_reservable = (source.getValue('u_trireservablebl') == 'TRUE');
  target.wsd_assignment_type = (source.getValue('u_trireservablebl') == 'TRUE') ? 'flex' : 'permanent';
  target.active = (source.getValue('u_tristatus') == 'Active');
  var occ = source.getValue('u_triprimaryoccupant');
  target.description = 'Migrated from TRIRIGA (' + source.getValue('u_trispaceclass') + ')' + (occ ? '. Primary occupant: ' + occ : '');
})(source, map, log, target);]]></script><source_table>x_189579_wsddemo_tririga_space_import</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_map</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-28 19:45:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>330b05d0c3d0571014d3b91ed4013162</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Summit Bank - TRIRIGA Space to WSD Space</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Summit Bank WSD Demo" source="x_189579_wsddemo">ffda0990c3d0571014d3b91ed40131cb</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Summit Bank WSD Demo">ffda0990c3d0571014d3b91ed40131cb</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_map_330b05d0c3d0571014d3b91ed4013162</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-28 19:45:34</sys_updated_on><target_table>sn_wsd_core_space</target_table></sys_transform_map></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_script"><sys_transform_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><map display_value="Summit Bank - TRIRIGA Space to WSD Space">330b05d0c3d0571014d3b91ed4013162</map><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[(function runTransformScript(source, map, log, target) {
  // Carry TRIRIGA primary occupants over to WSD: each employee has ONE workplace profile,
  // so the occupant's profile is pointed at the migrated space.
  var occ = source.getValue('u_triprimaryoccupant');
  if (!occ) return;
  var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
  if (!u.get('user_name', occ)) { log.warn('TRIRIGA occupant not found in ServiceNow: ' + occ); return; }
  var p = new GlideRecord('sn_wsd_core_workplace_profile');
  p.addQuery('employee', u.getUniqueValue());
  p.query();
  if (p.next()) {
    if (p.getValue('workplace_location') && p.getValue('workplace_location') != target.getUniqueValue())
      log.warn('Occupant ' + occ + ' already had a different primary location; WSD keeps one per person. Moved to ' + target.getValue('name') + ' - review for duplicate TRIRIGA assignments.');
    p.workplace_location = target.getUniqueValue(); p.active = true; p.update();
  } else {
    p.initialize(); p.employee = u.getUniqueValue(); p.workplace_location = target.getUniqueValue(); p.active = true; p.insert();
  }
})(source, map, log, target);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_transform_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-28 19:45:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>cc1bc5d0c3d0571014d3b91ed401319b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>onAfter</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Summit Bank WSD Demo" source="x_189579_wsddemo">ffda0990c3d0571014d3b91ed40131cb</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Summit Bank WSD Demo">ffda0990c3d0571014d3b91ed40131cb</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_script_cc1bc5d0c3d0571014d3b91ed401319b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-28 19:45:34</sys_updated_on><when>onAfter</when></sys_transform_script></record_update>
